column3: The paper extends the proof of Theorem 9 to nonbinary trees ("Theorem 9 also extends, noting that if the root of the species tree has degree greater than 2, then its location will be identified by some 5-taxon subtree with the same property", l.995), not its statement, which assumes binary trees; the formal proof applies the same argument, rl_nb_theorem9 (Nonbinary/Theorem9.lean), with the case of a root of degree greater than 2.

The paper extends the proof of Corollary 10 ("The proof of Corollary 10 did not use the assumption that σ⁺ is binary, so it applies to nonbinary species trees as well", l.996), not its statement; the formal proof applies the same argument, c10_of_theorem9 (Identifiability/Corollary10.lean), which also proves corollary10.
